name: myprogram
description: Connect ChatGPT to your MyProgram account: read your training week, write or change your programs (you confirm them in the app), and log foods, dishes and meals in your nutrition journal.

interface.longDescription:
MyProgram is a training and nutrition app. Connect your MyProgram account and ChatGPT works from your real data instead of guessing.

• Your week: the sessions your programs plan, what you actually did (sets, reps, loads, duration) and what is left.
• Your programs: ChatGPT can write a complete new program, or a new version of one of your own programs ("swap squats for leg press from next week"). Nothing changes in your account until you review it and confirm it in the MyProgram app.
• Your nutrition: ChatGPT can add a food to your foods, save a recipe as a dish, and log what you ate in your journal. You can edit or delete every line in the app.
• Your wellness data (discomforts, sleep and recovery) is read only if you have given your consent to health data in the app, so the programs ChatGPT writes take them into account. MyProgram is not a medical service: no diagnosis, no treatment.

Requires a MyProgram Pro subscription. You can remove ChatGPT's access at any time, in the app (Profile → Integrations) or from ChatGPT.
capabilities: Log meals in your nutrition journal
defaultPrompt: How is my training week going?
Write me a 4-week strength program and add it to MyProgram.

positive.prompt: How is my training week going in MyProgram?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize this week's sessions from the test account's program "Strength Builder – 8 weeks" (exercises, sets, target loads), say which are done or still to do, and use only the numbers the tool returns.

positive.description: Write and import a new program
positive.prompt: Write me a 4-week strength program, 3 sessions a week on Monday, Wednesday and Friday, and add it to MyProgram.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the profile and wellness data, take the declared right-knee discomfort into account (and say so in the program's advice), write all 12 sessions and import them. The answer gives the one-time import code and link, and says the program enters the account only after confirmation in the app.

positive.prompt: In my program "Strength Builder – 8 weeks", replace the back squat with the leg press from week 3.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the program, read it, submit a new version where the back squat becomes the leg press from week 3, and explain that the change waits for confirmation in the app and leaves past sessions untouched.

positive.prompt: Log my lunch for today in MyProgram: 150 g of grilled chicken breast, 200 g of cooked white rice and a tablespoon of olive oil.
positive.expected_behavior: Log three lines in today's lunch with calories and protein for each quantity, say the values are estimates, and call the tool only once.

positive.description: Save a recipe as a dish
positive.prompt: Save my overnight oats as a dish in MyProgram: 60 g of rolled oats, 200 ml of semi-skimmed milk and 100 g of blueberries.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a one-portion dish with the three ingredients and their values, and give the total calories and protein.

negative.prompt: Delete all my programs in MyProgram.
Show me the training week of my friend Marc in MyProgram.
Diagnose the pain in my knee and prescribe a treatment.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your training week and wellness data, write a new program or change one of yours (confirmed in the app), and log foods, dishes and meals.

fr-FR.subtitle: Ton entraînement dans ChatGPT
fr-FR.description:
MyProgram est une app d'entraînement et de nutrition. Connecte ton compte MyProgram et ChatGPT travaille sur tes vraies données au lieu de deviner.

• Ta semaine : les séances prévues par tes programmes, ce que tu as vraiment fait (séries, reps, charges, durée) et ce qui reste.
• Tes programmes : ChatGPT peut écrire un nouveau programme complet, ou une nouvelle version d'un de tes programmes (« remplace le squat par la presse à partir de la semaine prochaine »). Rien ne change dans ton compte avant que tu relises et confirmes dans l'app MyProgram.
• Ta nutrition : ChatGPT peut ajouter un aliment, enregistrer une recette comme plat et noter ce que tu as mangé dans ton journal. Tu corriges ou supprimes chaque ligne dans l'app.
• Ta forme (gênes, sommeil, récupération) n'est lue que si tu as donné ton accord aux données de santé dans l'app, pour que les programmes écrits en tiennent compte. MyProgram n'est pas un service médical : ni diagnostic, ni traitement.

Nécessite un abonnement MyProgram Pro. Tu retires l'accès de ChatGPT quand tu veux, dans l'app (Profil → Intégrations) ou depuis ChatGPT.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu entrenamiento en ChatGPT
es-ES.description:
MyProgram es una app de entrenamiento y nutrición. Conecta tu cuenta de MyProgram y ChatGPT trabaja con tus datos reales en lugar de adivinar.

• Tu semana: las sesiones que prevén tus programas, lo que has hecho de verdad (series, repeticiones, cargas, duración) y lo que queda.
• Tus programas: ChatGPT puede escribir un programa nuevo completo, o una nueva versión de uno de tus programas («cambia la sentadilla por la prensa a partir de la semana que viene»). Nada cambia en tu cuenta hasta que lo revises y lo confirmes en la app MyProgram.
• Tu nutrición: ChatGPT puede añadir un alimento, guardar una receta como plato y anotar lo que has comido en tu diario. Puedes corregir o eliminar cada línea en la app.
• Tu forma (molestias, sueño, recuperación) solo se lee si has dado tu consentimiento a los datos de salud en la app, para que los programas lo tengan en cuenta. MyProgram no es un servicio médico: ni diagnóstico ni tratamiento.

Requiere una suscripción MyProgram Pro. Puedes retirar el acceso de ChatGPT cuando quieras, en la app (Perfil → Integraciones) o desde ChatGPT.
